race.en: Several teams entered the race despite the hot weather.
race.zh: 儘管天氣炎熱，仍有好幾支隊伍參加比賽。

radio.en: The radio reported heavy traffic on the highway this morning.
radio.zh: 收音機今早報導高速公路交通壅塞。

rain.en: The rain became heavier just before we reached the station.
rain.zh: 就在我們抵達車站前，雨勢變得更大。

raise.en: The school hopes to raise enough money for new library books.
raise.zh: 學校希望募到足夠的錢購買新的圖書館書籍。

range.en: The course covers a wide range of topics in environmental science.
range.zh: 這門課涵蓋環境科學中廣泛的主題。

rapid.en: The city experienced rapid growth during the past decade.
rapid.zh: 這座城市在過去十年間快速成長。

rapidly.en: Technology is changing rapidly in many areas of daily life.
rapidly.zh: 科技正在日常生活的許多領域快速改變。

rare.en: It is rare to see snow in this part of Taiwan.
rare.zh: 在台灣這個地區看到下雪很少見。

rate.en: The report shows that the recycling rate increased last year.
rate.zh: 報告顯示去年的回收率提高了。

rather.en: I would rather walk than wait twenty minutes for the bus.
rather.zh: 我寧願走路，也不想等二十分鐘的公車。

reach.en: We expect to reach the mountain shelter before sunset.
reach.zh: 我們預計在日落前抵達山屋。

react.en: Different materials react differently when they are exposed to heat.
react.zh: 不同材料受熱時會有不同反應。

reaction.en: The experiment produced a visible reaction within a few seconds.
reaction.zh: 實驗在幾秒內產生了明顯反應。

read.en: Please read the passage carefully before answering the questions.
read.zh: 回答問題前請仔細閱讀文章。

reader.en: A good title helps the reader understand the topic quickly.
reader.zh: 好的標題能幫助讀者快速了解主題。

ready.en: The students were ready to begin when the teacher arrived.
ready.zh: 老師到達時，學生已經準備好開始了。

real.en: The project asks students to solve a real problem in their community.
real.zh: 這項專題要求學生解決社區中的真實問題。

realize.en: She began to realize how important regular review was.
realize.zh: 她開始了解到規律複習有多重要。

really.en: This example really helps explain the idea more clearly.
really.zh: 這個例子真的讓這個觀念更容易理解。

reason.en: Please give one reason for choosing that answer.
reason.zh: 請說明你選擇那個答案的一個理由。

reasonable.en: The teacher gave us a reasonable amount of time to finish.
reasonable.zh: 老師給了我們合理的時間完成任務。

receive.en: Students will receive their test results next Monday.
receive.zh: 學生會在下星期一收到考試結果。

recent.en: A recent study examined how sleep affects student performance.
recent.zh: 最近一項研究探討睡眠如何影響學生表現。

recently.en: The school recently added more computers to the library.
recently.zh: 學校最近在圖書館增設了更多電腦。

recognize.en: Students should learn to recognize common patterns in academic writing.
recognize.zh: 學生應學會辨識學術寫作中常見的模式。

recommend.en: Teachers often recommend regular reading to improve vocabulary.
recommend.zh: 老師常建議透過規律閱讀來增進字彙量。

record.en: Please record your observations immediately after the experiment.
record.zh: 實驗後請立即記錄你的觀察結果。

recover.en: The athlete needed several weeks to recover from the injury.
recover.zh: 這名運動員需要幾週才能從受傷中恢復。

reduce.en: Turning off unused lights can reduce energy consumption.
reduce.zh: 關掉不用的燈可以減少能源消耗。

refer.en: You can refer to the chart when answering this question.
refer.zh: 回答這題時可以參考圖表。

reflect.en: The final paragraph should reflect the main idea of your essay.
reflect.zh: 最後一段應呼應你文章的主要觀點。

refuse.en: He refused to give up even after several failed attempts.
refuse.zh: 即使失敗了好幾次，他仍拒絕放棄。

region.en: This region receives heavy rainfall during the summer months.
region.zh: 這個地區夏季會有大量降雨。

regular.en: Regular practice is important for building strong language skills.
regular.zh: 規律練習對建立扎實語言能力很重要。

regularly.en: She regularly reviews new words before going to bed.
regularly.zh: 她會固定在睡前複習新單字。

relation.en: The study explores the relation between exercise and concentration.
relation.zh: 這項研究探討運動與專注力之間的關係。

relationship.en: A good relationship requires trust and clear communication.
relationship.zh: 良好的關係需要信任與清楚溝通。

relative.en: The relative importance of each factor depends on the situation.
relative.zh: 每個因素的相對重要性取決於情況。

relax.en: Listening to quiet music can help students relax after studying.
relax.zh: 讀書後聽安靜的音樂可以幫助學生放鬆。

release.en: The organization will release the final report next week.
release.zh: 這個組織會在下週發布最終報告。

reliable.en: Students should use reliable sources when writing research reports.
reliable.zh: 學生撰寫研究報告時應使用可靠來源。

relief.en: Finishing the final exam brought a sense of relief.
relief.zh: 完成期末考讓人有種鬆一口氣的感覺。

remain.en: Please remain seated until the teacher finishes the instructions.
remain.zh: 請保持坐著，直到老師說明完畢。

remember.en: I use a short review to remember difficult vocabulary better.
remember.zh: 我用簡短複習來更牢記困難單字。

remind.en: Please remind me to bring the science worksheet tomorrow.
remind.zh: 請提醒我明天帶自然科學習單。

remove.en: Please remove your shoes before entering the room.

repeat.en: The teacher asked us to repeat the sentence more clearly.
repeat.zh: 老師請我們把句子再清楚重複一次。

replace.en: The school plans to replace several old computers this year.
replace.zh: 學校計畫今年汰換幾台老舊電腦。

reply.en: Please reply to the email before Friday afternoon.
reply.zh: 請在星期五下午前回覆這封電子郵件。

report.en: Each group must submit a short report after the experiment.
report.zh: 每個小組都必須在實驗後繳交一份簡短報告。

represent.en: Each symbol on the map represents a different type of place.
represent.zh: 地圖上的每個符號代表不同類型的地點。

request.en: The office received a request for additional study materials.
request.zh: 辦公室收到一項要求提供額外學習材料的申請。

require.en: This experiment will require careful measurement and accurate records.
require.zh: 這項實驗需要仔細測量與準確記錄。

research.en: The students conducted research on how noise affects learning.
research.zh: 學生進行了噪音如何影響學習的研究。

researcher.en: The researcher interviewed students from several different schools.
researcher.zh: 研究人員訪問了來自數所不同學校的學生。

reserve.en: We need to reserve the meeting room before Friday.
reserve.zh: 我們需要在星期五前預訂會議室。

resource.en: The library is an important resource for students doing research.
resource.zh: 圖書館是學生做研究時的重要資源。

respect.en: Students should respect different opinions during class discussions.
respect.zh: 學生在課堂討論時應尊重不同意見。

respond.en: Please respond clearly to each question on the form.
respond.zh: 請清楚回答表格上的每個問題。

response.en: Her response showed that she understood the main idea.
response.zh: 她的回答顯示她理解了主要觀念。

responsibility.en: Keeping the classroom clean is everyone's responsibility.
responsibility.zh: 維持教室整潔是每個人的責任。

responsible.en: Students are responsible for bringing their own materials to class.
responsible.zh: 學生有責任自行攜帶上課材料。

rest.en: A short rest can help you concentrate better afterward.
rest.zh: 短暫休息可以幫助你之後更專心。

restaurant.en: The restaurant uses local vegetables in many of its dishes.
restaurant.zh: 這家餐廳在許多料理中使用當地蔬菜。

result.en: The result was different from what we had expected.
result.zh: 結果和我們原本預期的不一樣。

return.en: Please return the borrowed book by next Monday.
return.zh: 請在下星期一前歸還借閱的書。

review.en: A quick review before class can improve your understanding.
review.zh: 上課前快速複習可以提升理解。

reward.en: The teacher gave a small reward to the winning team.
reward.zh: 老師給優勝隊伍一個小獎勵。

rice.en: Rice is an important food in many parts of Asia.
rice.zh: 米飯是亞洲許多地區的重要食物。

rich.en: The soil is rich enough to support many kinds of plants.
rich.zh: 這片土壤很肥沃，足以讓多種植物生長。

ride.en: We decided to ride our bicycles along the river.
ride.zh: 我們決定騎腳踏車沿著河邊前進。

right.en: Make sure you choose the right file before uploading it.
right.zh: 上傳前要確認你選的是正確檔案。

ring.en: The school bell will ring at eight o'clock.
ring.zh: 學校鐘聲會在八點響起。

rise.en: Temperatures often rise quickly after the sun comes out.
rise.zh: 太陽出來後，氣溫通常會快速上升。

risk.en: Sharing passwords online creates a serious security risk.
risk.zh: 在網路上分享密碼會造成嚴重的安全風險。

river.en: The river becomes wider as it approaches the sea.
river.zh: 這條河接近海洋時會變得更寬。

road.en: The road was closed because of a landslide after heavy rain.
road.zh: 大雨後發生土石滑落，因此道路封閉。

role.en: Each student has a different role in the group project.
role.zh: 每位學生在小組專題中都有不同角色。

room.en: The room was quiet enough for everyone to study.
room.zh: 房間很安靜，大家都能讀書。

rough.en: The sea was rough because of the strong wind.
rough.zh: 因為強風，海面非常顛簸。

round.en: We sat around a round table for the discussion.
round.zh: 我們圍著一張圓桌進行討論。

route.en: This bus route connects the station with the university.
route.zh: 這條公車路線連接車站與大學。

rule.en: Every student must follow the same safety rule in the laboratory.
rule.zh: 每位學生在實驗室都必須遵守相同的安全規定。

run.en: The program will run automatically after you press the button.
run.zh: 按下按鈕後，程式會自動執行。

safe.en: Keep the chemicals in a safe place away from children.
safe.zh: 請把化學物品放在遠離孩童的安全位置。

safety.en: Safety should always come first during laboratory activities.
safety.zh: 進行實驗室活動時，安全永遠應放在第一位。

same.en: The two experiments used the same amount of water.
same.zh: 這兩個實驗使用了相同的水量。

sample.en: The students examined a small sample under the microscope.
sample.zh: 學生在顯微鏡下觀察一小份樣本。

save.en: Remember to save your document before closing the program.
save.zh: 關閉程式前記得儲存文件。

say.en: Please say your answer clearly so everyone can hear it.
say.zh: 請清楚說出答案，讓大家都聽得到。

scale.en: The map uses a simple scale to show distance.
scale.zh: 這張地圖使用簡單比例尺來表示距離。

school.en: Our school will hold a science fair next month.
school.zh: 我們學校下個月會舉辦科展。

science.en: Science helps us explain many patterns in the natural world.
science.zh: 科學幫助我們解釋自然界中的許多現象。

scientific.en: A scientific explanation should be supported by clear evidence.
scientific.zh: 科學解釋應該由明確證據支持。

scientist.en: The scientist repeated the experiment to confirm the result.
scientist.zh: 科學家重複實驗以確認結果。

score.en: Her score improved after several weeks of regular practice.
score.zh: 經過幾週規律練習後，她的分數提高了。

screen.en: The answer will appear on the screen after you submit.
screen.zh: 提交後答案會出現在螢幕上。

search.en: Students can search the library database for useful sources.
search.zh: 學生可以搜尋圖書館資料庫來找有用來源。

season.en: Spring is my favorite season because the weather is mild.
season.zh: 春天是我最喜歡的季節，因為天氣溫和。

seat.en: Please take your seat before the presentation begins.

second.en: The second experiment produced a more accurate result.
second.zh: 第二次實驗得到更準確的結果。

section.en: Read the final section before answering the last question.
section.zh: 回答最後一題前請閱讀最後一節。

see.en: We can see a clear pattern in the final graph.
see.zh: 我們可以在最後的圖表中看出明顯模式。

seem.en: The task may seem difficult at first, but practice helps.
seem.zh: 這項任務一開始可能看起來很難，但練習會有幫助。

select.en: Please select one topic for your final presentation.
select.zh: 請為期末報告選擇一個主題。

sell.en: The school club will sell snacks to raise money.
sell.zh: 學校社團會賣點心來募款。

send.en: Please send the completed file to your teacher by Friday.
send.zh: 請在星期五前把完成的檔案寄給老師。

sense.en: The explanation makes more sense after seeing the diagram.
sense.zh: 看過圖示後，這個解釋就更容易理解。

sentence.en: Write one sentence using each of the new vocabulary words.
sentence.zh: 請用每個新單字各寫一句話。

separate.en: Please separate the paper from the plastic before recycling.
separate.zh: 回收前請把紙類和塑膠分開。

series.en: The teacher showed a series of images to explain the process.
series.zh: 老師展示一系列圖片來說明這個過程。

serious.en: Air pollution is a serious problem in many large cities.
serious.zh: 空氣污染是許多大城市的嚴重問題。

serve.en: This chart can serve as a useful summary of the results.
serve.zh: 這張圖表可以作為結果的實用摘要。

service.en: The library provides an online service for renewing borrowed books.
service.zh: 圖書館提供線上續借服務。

set.en: The teacher set a clear deadline for the final project.
set.zh: 老師為期末專題設定了明確期限。

several.en: Several students volunteered to help with the school event.
several.zh: 有幾位學生自願協助學校活動。

share.en: Students should share useful ideas during group discussions.
share.zh: 學生應在小組討論中分享有用想法。

short.en: The teacher gave us a short quiz at the end of class.
short.zh: 老師在下課前給我們一份簡短小考。

show.en: The graph shows how temperatures changed during the week.
show.zh: 這張圖表顯示一週內氣溫如何變化。

side.en: Please write your name on the left side of the page.
side.zh: 請把名字寫在頁面的左側。

sign.en: The sign clearly explains where visitors should wait.
sign.zh: 這個標誌清楚說明訪客應在哪裡等候。

signal.en: The red signal means that the machine should stop.
signal.zh: 紅色訊號表示機器應停止運作。

similar.en: The two articles present similar ideas in different ways.
similar.zh: 這兩篇文章用不同方式呈現相似觀點。

simple.en: A simple example can make a difficult concept easier to understand.
simple.zh: 簡單例子能讓困難概念更容易理解。

simply.en: The teacher simply asked us to explain our reasoning clearly.
simply.zh: 老師只是要求我們清楚說明推理過程。

since.en: The school has changed a lot since I first arrived.
since.zh: 自從我剛來時起，學校已經改變很多。

single.en: A single mistake can affect the final calculation.
single.zh: 一個小錯誤就可能影響最後計算。

site.en: The new school building site is near the sports field.
site.zh: 新校舍的工地位於運動場附近。

situation.en: We need more information before judging the situation.
situation.zh: 在判斷情況前，我們需要更多資訊。

skill.en: Reading regularly can improve both vocabulary and comprehension skills.
skill.zh: 規律閱讀可以提升字彙與理解能力。

sleep.en: Enough sleep is important for memory and concentration.
sleep.zh: 充足睡眠對記憶力和專注力很重要。

small.en: A small change in temperature affected the final result.
small.zh: 溫度的一點小變化影響了最後結果。

social.en: Social media can spread information very quickly.
social.zh: 社群媒體可以非常快速地傳播資訊。

society.en: Technology has changed many aspects of modern society.
society.zh: 科技改變了現代社會的許多面向。

solution.en: The team proposed a practical solution to the traffic problem.
solution.zh: 團隊提出了一個實際的交通問題解決方案。

solve.en: Students worked together to solve the difficult problem.
solve.zh: 學生合作解決這個困難問題。

some.en: Some students prefer studying alone, while others like groups.
some.zh: 有些學生喜歡自己讀書，其他人則喜歡小組學習。

someone.en: Someone left a notebook on the desk after class.
someone.zh: 下課後有人把筆記本留在桌上。

something.en: There is something unusual about the final result.
something.zh: 最後結果有一些不尋常的地方。

sometimes.en: Students sometimes need extra time to understand difficult ideas.
sometimes.zh: 學生有時需要更多時間理解困難觀念。

source.en: Always check whether the source is reliable before using it.
source.zh: 使用資訊前要先確認來源是否可靠。

space.en: The new library has more space for quiet study.
space.zh: 新圖書館有更多安靜讀書的空間。

speak.en: Please speak slowly so everyone can understand you.
speak.zh: 請說慢一點，讓每個人都能理解。

special.en: The school organized a special event for graduating students.
special.zh: 學校為畢業生舉辦了一場特別活動。

specific.en: Please give a specific example to support your answer.
specific.zh: 請舉一個具體例子支持你的答案。

speech.en: She practiced her speech several times before the competition.
speech.zh: 比賽前她把演講練習了好幾次。

spend.en: I spend about an hour reviewing English every evening.
spend.zh: 我每天晚上大約花一小時複習英文。

standard.en: The report follows the same standard used by other schools.
standard.zh: 這份報告採用其他學校也使用的相同標準。

start.en: Please start the experiment only after reading the instructions.
start.zh: 請在看完說明後才開始實驗。

state.en: The report describes the current state of the local environment.
state.zh: 這份報告描述當地環境目前的狀況。

statement.en: The statement is supported by evidence from several studies.
statement.zh: 這項陳述有多項研究證據支持。

stay.en: We decided to stay indoors because of the heavy rain.
stay.zh: 因為大雨，我們決定待在室內。

step.en: Follow each step carefully to avoid making mistakes.
step.zh: 請仔細按照每個步驟，以避免犯錯。

still.en: The room was still quiet even after the class ended.
still.zh: 即使下課後，房間仍然很安靜。

story.en: The story shows how one decision can change a person's life.
story.zh: 這個故事顯示一個決定如何改變一個人的人生。

strategy.en: A good strategy can make difficult study tasks easier.
strategy.zh: 好的策略可以讓困難的學習任務更容易。

strong.en: A strong argument needs clear reasons and reliable evidence.
strong.zh: 有力的論點需要清楚理由和可靠證據。

student.en: Each student must complete the survey before Friday.
student.zh: 每位學生都必須在星期五前完成問卷。

study.en: Regular study habits can improve performance over time.
study.zh: 規律的讀書習慣能逐漸提升表現。

subject.en: Math is the subject I find most challenging this year.
subject.zh: 數學是我今年覺得最有挑戰的科目。

success.en: Careful preparation played an important role in the team's success.
success.zh: 仔細準備在團隊成功中扮演重要角色。

successful.en: The project was successful because everyone completed their tasks.
successful.zh: 這項專題很成功，因為每個人都完成了自己的工作。

such.en: Such examples can help students understand abstract ideas more easily.
such.zh: 這類例子能幫助學生更容易理解抽象觀念。

sudden.en: A sudden change in weather forced us to leave early.
sudden.zh: 天氣突然改變，迫使我們提早離開。

suggest.en: The results suggest that regular practice improves memory.
suggest.zh: 結果顯示規律練習有助於提升記憶。

support.en: Use evidence from the passage to support your answer.
support.zh: 請用文章中的證據支持你的答案。

sure.en: Make sure the file is saved before closing the program.
sure.zh: 關閉程式前要確認檔案已經儲存。

system.en: The new system makes it easier to track student progress.
system.zh: 新系統讓追蹤學生進度變得更容易。
